title: Stepwise timing fingerprint & KV-hit costing pipeline
creator: Asha Patel
description: Introduce a lightweight stepwise timing fingerprint and KV-hit costing pipeline to attribute per-token latency and incremental cost to model emissions. Goal is accurate per-token SLO attribution for latency-sensitive customers and to quantify the economic impact of KV cache hits/misses across request shapes.
acceptance_criteria: Instrumentation emits a compact per-step timing fingerprint for 100% of production requests to the token-attribution topic
Span and tag conventions documented and validated in a test harness (unit + integration)
Cost model calculates per-token incremental GPU time and KV penalty with <5% error vs offline simulation for sampled workloads
Dashboard shows token-level P50/P95/P99 breakdown by cache-hit state, model, and route; alerts fire for regressions
End-to-end PR merged, infra provisioning completed, and rollout plan executed to 20% traffic without regressions
technical_notes: We will add a new lightweight tracing hook in the serving runtime that emits one compact fingerprint per emission step: {step_index, emit_ms_delta, kv_hit_boolean, batch_cohort, model_variant}. Use protobuf v2 message 'StepFingerprint' to minimize payload. Fingerprints are aggregated in a kafka topic 'token-attribution-v2' with a dedicated consumer that reconstructs per-request histograms and computes KV-adjusted token cost. To avoid high cardinality, batch_cohort and model_variant should be mapped to stable small integers. Sampling of full spans will remain for debug but production will use fingerprint-only.
telemetry_schema: StepFingerprint(fields: step_index:int, delta_ms:int, kv_hit:bool, batch_cohort:int, model_id:string, variant:int, request_id:string, approximate_token_hash:int)
sampling_strategy: Default: deterministic 1% full-span sampling (trace_id hash mod 100). Fingerprint emissions sampled at 100% but payload is compact. Increase full-span sampling to 5% for canary rollout windows. Allow per-customer opt-in for 100% full spans via config flag.
progress_updates: 2026-03-08: RFC reviewed with observability and runtime teams. Agreed on protobuf fingerprint schema and kafka topic name.
2026-03-10: Prototype hook added to runtime; local micro-bench shows ~0.6% p90 tail increase when emitting full-step spans; fingerprint-only cost ~0.04%.
2026-03-12: Consumer skeleton implemented to aggregate per-request histograms; initial cost model plugged using measured per-step GPU microsecond multipliers.
2026-03-14: Integration test added; staging cluster ingestion validated at 5k rps with no partition lag.
next_steps: Finish PR for runtime hook and land in staging
Finalize cost multipliers after pod-level profiling during mixed workloads
Extend console dashboard with per-route token-cost explorer and alert thresholds
Plan canary rollout (20% -> 50% -> 100%) with incremental full-span sampling boosts
